- Refutes if: time saving < 0.5%. Infeasible = gate lottery (no re-roll). Tip = E082 (0.7556, 4.584 s; one-process
  means of this math 0.7534-0.7542). Changes are math-identical to E082 (unit tests: lookahead and resize max diff 0;

## Contingencies
<!-- The next step for each outcome, decided now. -->
- If it lands in the predicted range: keep if feasible (new best); else discard, no re-roll.
- If it moves the right way but less than predicted: (saving 0.5-1%) keep if feasible.
- If it moves the opposite way: discard; investigate the harness-specific prepare path.
- If it crashes: check the pinned staging / buffer shapes in the worker.
